mini-can.wrapper_caveat: The frozen UIFlow2 release image's Python unit/can.py wrapper is unusable on this firmware build (TypeError / ESP_ERR_INVALID_ARG); the probe drives the same official m5can C module (bus 0, default 125 kbit/s timing) the wrapper subclasses.
